documentTitle: Pray Times — a calmer prayer app and widget
documentDescription: A private prayer app and home-screen widget for the next prayer, today’s schedule, qibla, and trusted alerts.
heroLead: A calm app for the next prayer, your daily schedule, qibla, and trusted alerts—with a home-screen widget that keeps it all close.
localOnly: App and widget — no account or tracking
livePreview: Live Pray Times mobile app preview
choosePreviewCity: Choose a city for the preview
doNotShowUnverified: We will not show an unverified time.
featuresEyebrow: YOUR WHOLE DAY IN ONE CALM APP
featuresTitle: The right detail, exactly when you need it.
featuresIntro: From Today to Qibla and Settings, every surface is designed to answer quickly without adding visual noise.
beforeText: See the next prayer and countdown without opening the app.
nowText: Verified times, qibla, Ramadan guidance, alerts, a selected ayah, and a clear calculation method for every place.
widgetTitle: The next prayer, closer than ever.
widgetBody: Add the widget to your home screen for the next prayer and countdown, or choose the medium size to keep today’s full schedule in view.
methodBody: Every displayed time passes three clear checks. If the city, day, or calculation method does not match, we do not show it.
coordinateBody: Choose an offline preset, search anywhere, or use your location by choice. Coordinates are pinned before prayer times are verified.
dateBody: We compare the date, time zone, and coordinates returned by the provider before displaying a result.
methodBodyCard: We suggest a calculation method by country, and you can change it per place.
privacyLead: Location is not a vague request.
privacyBody: No account or tracking. Places and preferences stay on your device; search text is sent only while finding a city, and current-location coordinates are reduced in precision before use.
verseUnavailable: A verse appears when a connection is available.
closingTitle:
Start on the web.
Take the experience with you.
footer: A calm app for a day that begins at Fajr and ends at Isha.

features.title: Any city worldwide
features.body: Search in Arabic or English, or choose a built-in Saudi preset that is ready before you search.

features.title: Location, only by choice
features.body: Location is requested only after your tap, then coordinates are coarsened and the time zone is pinned.

features.title: Qibla compass
features.body: A direction calculated from your place to the Kaaba, with optional alignment to your device heading.

features.title: Ramadan and sunrise
features.body: Suhoor and iftar guidance during Ramadan, plus sunrise to show when the Fajr window closes.

features.title: Widgets and alerts
features.body: Two home-screen sizes for iOS and Android, plus notifications for the prayers you choose.

features.title: A method suited to the place
features.body: A country-based suggestion with a per-place override, verified before any time is displayed.
